prose: The prolific decoder of all things legal, Clint Richardson, returns to InnerVerse for an extended rap on patriot myths that might get people into trouble. We talk extensively about the "redemption" process, revoking one's citizenship, and more. Also covered in this chat is Unidroit (from Rome), and the attempt from powers that be to make worldwide law into a uniform system. Another major segment of this 3 hour conversation revolves around the Public legal world in contrast to the Private common law, and whether forming Private Members Only Associations could be a tool for circumventing legal tyranny and unwanted regulation or taxation.
links: Clint Richardson, Red Pill Sunday School
